roles.title: Role templates
roles.intro: Reusable definitions and local bindings. Templates do not create member sessions.
roles.empty: No role templates yet. Create a reusable role to start.
roles.name: Role name
roles.exportNotice: Inline prompts belong to the portable definition. Referenced persona prompts stay local and require a persona binding after import.
roles.logicalSlots: Logical slots (type a name and press Enter)
roles.limitsNotice: Configure limits for future runs. Freezing and enforcement are delivered by the subsequent run tasks. Empty fields inherit the profile or default.

roles.versionNotice: Saving creates a new version. Historical definitions are preserved.
roles.personaDependency: Local persona dependency; prompt is not embedded

v2.scope: Autonomous teams and workflows share frozen roles, contracted results, scheduling, controls and recovery. Waiting releases execution capacity; unknown external effects require confirmation.
v2.emptyAssets: No workflow assets yet. Create a role template, then save a workflow.
v2.noResult: No completed result has been submitted.
v2.name: Workflow name
v2.inputHint: Use unique names such as topic, audience.
v2.taskHint: Use {topic} to insert a declared input. Double braces escape literal braces.
v2.contractHint: Leave empty for non-empty text. Use an object schema for structured results; files contains stable file_id references.
v2.revisionHint: A revision preserves earlier versions and does not rerun consumers. Edit the selected version; if a newer version exists, select it first.

progress.title: Execution progress
progress.noAttention: No task needs attention at this time.
progress.context: Each member continues its context within this run. New runs use isolated conversations.
progress.emptyProcess: No completed member response or tool result yet.
progress.observation: Process records belong to a task, attempt and member. The observation cursor reconnects this page; it does not restore invocation checkpoints.

graph.dragHint: Drag a role onto the canvas or click to add a task.
graph.memberHint: Tasks with the same key share a conversation and execute serially.
graph.referenceHint: Reference an upstream required scalar field and use {input_alias} in instructions. Its artifact version is pinned at task start.
graph.valueHint: Use true/false, a number, null or text matching the declared field type.
graph.conditionHint: An unmatched edge skips its path. Merges wait for active paths; skipped paths do not block completion.
graph.selectHint: Select a task or dependency to edit its properties.
graph.footer: Drag nodes to arrange · Connect right and left handles · Save a version before running
graph.runHint: Read-only frozen definition · Select a task to inspect its actual status and pinned artifacts
graph.empty: Add your first task from the role toolbox.
graph.invalidJson: Enter a valid JSON output contract before saving.
graph.saveHint: Saving freezes this definition. Subsequent edits affect new runs.

resolution.savedWaiting: Your tool decision is saved for this Attempt. While the run is paused, it waits for Continue run. Local waits and execution capacity still apply.
resolution.replacedBy: Original outcome remains unknown; explicitly replaced by invocation
resolution.replaces: Explicit new execution for original invocation
resolution.unknown: No complete result proves this call finished. Inspect the original arguments, partial output and remote evidence before deciding.
resolution.evidence: Observed evidence or reason for your decision
resolution.retryWarning: A new execution may repeat an external effect. The original unknown call and your decision remain in history.

recovery.sameAttempt: Recovery keeps the original attempt and frozen configuration. It does not create a retry or a new iteration.
recovery.limits: Saved tool results are reused. Unstarted calls may execute; calls with unknown external effects need confirmation. A missing model response may require another request; partial generation and billing deduplication are not guaranteed.

boundaries.request: Saved model request; no complete response saved.
boundaries.response: Complete model response saved; reuse its original tool plan.
boundaries.tool_result: Tool result saved; recover without repeating its external effect.
boundaries.tool_progress: Tool output saved; execution completion is not confirmed.
boundaries.tools_applied: Tool results applied to context; continue the next model step.

controls.title: Whole run controls

states.cancelled: Cancelled — no new work will start

controls.inFlight: In-flight external calls may still finish. Pausing or cancelling does not undo external effects.
controls.semantics: Continue and checkpoint recovery keep the same Attempt. Retry creates a new Attempt. A new iteration creates a new task and is a separate workflow action.
controls.resolveFirst: Resolve uncertain tool effects in Saved member process before retrying this task.
controls.originalInputs: Original frozen inputs and exact artifact versions
controls.usageRetained: Previous consumption and full process records remain in Saved member process, associated with their Attempt.
controls.retryHint: Create a new Attempt with these original inputs. New artifact versions are not selected automatically; existing failures, consumption and history are retained.
controls.cancelHint: Stop new dispatch and request cancellation from current executors. Saved results, history and external effects are retained.

human.title: Human requests
human.question: Question / approval reason
human.choices: Allowed answers (one per line; empty for free text)
human.pinHint: Connect the artifact task as a dependency. Preview and approval use this exact version.
human.localWait: Human waits release capacity. Independent branches continue; global pause is separate.
human.savedWaiting: Response saved. It will be consumed after the whole run continues.

loops.feedbackHint: Each later round explicitly replaces the selected input using the previous round result. First-round inputs use the task input configuration.
loops.rules: Disjoint task groups use validated scalar fields. Executed loops release outside consumers only after a passing exit. Unselected groups are skipped; reaching the limit requires attention.

autonomous.title: Autonomous Team
autonomous.explanation: Pin the coordinator and allowed role templates. Each run freezes their configuration; the coordinator creates independent members within these limits. Enter the goal when starting the run.
autonomous.name: Team name

child.contractHint: The child receives declared inputs and returns its pinned output contract. Parent waits release root capacity; member contexts stay independent.
child.unavailable: The pinned team version is unavailable. Choose an accessible version.

workflowCall.hint: Choose saved workflow versions and the task result returned to the coordinator. Only declared inputs and exact artifact versions cross the independent scope.

usage.title: Usage and limits
usage.limitHint: Blank fields add no ceiling. The root allowance includes the coordinator, members, retries and nested calls. Steps count each admitted model, tool or status-query delivery; the iteration ceiling applies to every loop.
usage.boundary: Reservations use estimates and limit new calls. Provider reports can exceed estimates or output caps; this is not a guarantee of zero overspend. Interrupted calls keep uncertain consumption. Tools without token reports show unknown usage.
